extName.message: Chapter Check — Lint Video Chapter Timestamps

extDesc.message: Live-lint the chapter timestamps you type in the YouTube Studio description editor and flag the exact line breaking the rules.

onboardingBody.message: Chapter Check watches the description editor on YouTube Studio and flags the exact line that breaks a YouTube chapter-activation rule — the moment you type it.

onboardingDisclaimer.message: Chapter Check predicts chapter activation. It does not control YouTube, does not edit your video, and does not send anything to any server.
